title: 3 Dividend Growth ETFs That Prioritize Rising Payouts Over Today’s Yield. One Returned 12.53% Over the Past Year, Another Just 5.40%
description: Three ETFs built around rising payouts instead of big yields have taken very different paths over the past year, and the reasons behind that gap reveal something important about how dividend growth investing actually works in practice.
